documents.title: Dei Verbum — Dogmatic Constitution on Divine Revelation
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Sets out the Catholic understanding of divine revelation, Scripture, Tradition and the Church's teaching office, and the place of Scripture in the Church's life.

documents.title: Verbum Domini — Post-Synodal Apostolic Exhortation on the Word of God
documents.author: Benedict XVI
documents.description: Post-synodal exhortation on the Word of God in the life and mission of the Church.

documents.title: Providentissimus Deus — Encyclical on the Study of Holy Scripture
documents.author: Leo XIII
documents.description: Leo XIII's encyclical on the study of Scripture: its inspiration and truth, how it is to be interpreted, and the response to rationalist criticism.

documents.title: Spiritus Paraclitus — Encyclical on St. Jerome
documents.author: Benedict XV
documents.description: Benedict XV's encyclical for the fifteenth centenary of St Jerome's death, on his biblical scholarship and the place of Scripture in the Church.

documents.title: Divino Afflante Spiritu — Encyclical on Promoting Biblical Studies
documents.author: Pius XII
documents.description: Pius XII's encyclical encouraging biblical scholarship from the original languages and the use of literary and historical methods.

documents.title: The Bible and Morality: Biblical Roots of Christian Conduct
documents.author: Pontifical Biblical Commission
documents.description: A document of the Pontifical Biblical Commission on the biblical foundations of Christian moral life.

documents.title: The Jewish People and Their Sacred Scriptures in the Christian Bible
documents.author: Pontifical Biblical Commission
documents.description: A document of the Pontifical Biblical Commission on the Jewish Scriptures and their place in the Christian Bible.

documents.title: Lumen Gentium — Dogmatic Constitution on the Church
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Presents the mystery of the Church, the People of God, the hierarchy, the laity, the universal call to holiness and the place of Mary.

documents.title: Sacrosanctum Concilium — Constitution on the Sacred Liturgy
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Sets out principles for the renewal and promotion of the sacred liturgy.

documents.title: Gaudium et Spes — Pastoral Constitution on the Church in the Modern World
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Treats the Church in the modern world: the dignity of the person, human community, human activity, marriage, culture, economic and political life, and peace.

documents.title: Nostra Aetate — Declaration on the Relation of the Church to Non-Christian Religions
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Declares the Church's relation to non-Christian religions, with particular attention to Judaism.

documents.title: Unitatis Redintegratio — Decree on Ecumenism
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Sets out Catholic principles of ecumenism and the relation to other Christian communities.

documents.title: Deus Caritas Est — Encyclical on Christian Love
documents.author: Benedict XVI
documents.description: Benedict XVI's first encyclical, on love as eros and agape and on the Church's charitable service.

documents.title: Spe Salvi — Encyclical on Christian Hope
documents.author: Benedict XVI
documents.description: Benedict XVI's encyclical on Christian hope and its grounds in Scripture and tradition.

documents.title: Evangelii Gaudium — Apostolic Exhortation on the Proclamation of the Gospel
documents.author: Francis
documents.description: Francis's exhortation on proclaiming the Gospel in today's world, with attention to joy, mission and the poor.

documents.title: Dignitatis Humanae — Declaration on Religious Freedom
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Teaches that the human person has a right to religious freedom, grounded in human dignity and free from coercion by civil authority.

documents.title: Gravissimum Educationis — Declaration on Christian Education
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Sets out principles for education, the rights of parents and the role of Catholic schools and universities.

documents.title: Christus Dominus — Decree on the Pastoral Office of Bishops
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Describes the pastoral office of bishops in the universal Church and in their dioceses, and the role of episcopal conferences.

documents.title: Perfectae Caritatis — Decree on the Adaptation and Renewal of Religious Life
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Gives principles for the renewal of religious institutes in fidelity to the Gospel and to their founders.

documents.title: Optatam Totius — Decree on Priestly Training
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Describes the formation of seminarians, including spiritual life, studies and pastoral training.

documents.title: Apostolicam Actuositatem — Decree on the Apostolate of the Laity
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Describes the share of lay people in the Church's mission and the fields and forms of the lay apostolate.

documents.title: Ad Gentes — Decree on the Mission Activity of the Church
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Sets out the theological basis and practice of the Church's missionary work.

documents.title: Presbyterorum Ordinis — Decree on the Ministry and Life of Priests
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Treats the nature of the priesthood, priestly ministry and the spiritual life and support of priests.

documents.title: Orientalium Ecclesiarum — Decree on the Eastern Catholic Churches
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Affirms the dignity, rites and discipline of the Eastern Catholic Churches within the Catholic communion.

documents.title: Inter Mirifica — Decree on the Media of Social Communications
documents.author: Second Vatican Council
documents.description: Addresses the use of the press, film, radio and television in the Church's mission.

documents.title: Catechism of the Catholic Church
documents.author: John Paul II (promulgated)
documents.description: The universal catechism of the Catholic Church in four parts (creed, sacraments, moral life, prayer), promulgated by John Paul II in the apostolic constitution Fidei Depositum.

documents.title: Compendium of the Catechism of the Catholic Church
documents.author: Benedict XVI (approved)
documents.description: A question-and-answer summary of the Catechism of the Catholic Church in 598 numbered items.

documents.title: Fidei Depositum — Apostolic Constitution on the Publication of the Catechism
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Promulgates the Catechism of the Catholic Church and explains its purpose and place in the Church's teaching.

documents.title: Code of Canon Law (1983)
documents.author: John Paul II (promulgated)
documents.description: The current universal law of the Latin Church in seven books, promulgated by the apostolic constitution Sacrae Disciplinae Leges.

documents.title: Casti Connubii — Encyclical on Christian Marriage
documents.author: Pius XI
documents.description: Sets out the Church's teaching on the nature, ends and dignity of Christian marriage.

documents.title: Quadragesimo Anno — Encyclical on Reconstruction of the Social Order
documents.author: Pius XI
documents.description: Marks forty years since Rerum Novarum and develops Catholic social teaching, including the principle of subsidiarity.

documents.title: Mit Brennender Sorge — Encyclical on the Church and the German Reich
documents.author: Pius XI
documents.description: Addressed to the German bishops, it criticises the treatment of the Church under National Socialism and affirms faith, revelation and human rights.

documents.title: Divini Redemptoris — Encyclical on Atheistic Communism
documents.author: Pius XI
documents.description: Criticises communism as a doctrine and system and restates Catholic teaching on society and the dignity of the person.

documents.title: Mystici Corporis Christi — Encyclical on the Mystical Body of Christ
documents.author: Pius XII
documents.description: Presents the Church as the Mystical Body of Christ and treats the roles of the hierarchy, the faithful and the Holy Spirit.

documents.title: Mediator Dei — Encyclical on the Sacred Liturgy
documents.author: Pius XII
documents.description: A teaching on the nature and importance of the liturgy, the Eucharistic sacrifice, the liturgical year and the Divine Office.

documents.title: Humani Generis — Encyclical on Some False Opinions Threatening Catholic Doctrine
documents.author: Pius XII
documents.description: Addresses certain contemporary theological and philosophical opinions, including questions of evolution, revelation and the teaching authority of the Church.

documents.title: Munificentissimus Deus — Apostolic Constitution Defining the Assumption of Mary
documents.author: Pius XII
documents.description: Defines as a dogma that Mary, after her earthly life, was assumed body and soul into heavenly glory.

documents.title: Ad Caeli Reginam — Encyclical on the Queenship of Mary
documents.author: Pius XII
documents.description: Proclaims the queenship of Mary and gives its scriptural, patristic and liturgical foundations.

documents.title: Haurietis Aquas — Encyclical on Devotion to the Sacred Heart
documents.author: Pius XII
documents.description: Explains the biblical and theological basis of devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus.

documents.title: Mater et Magistra — Encyclical on Christianity and Social Progress
documents.author: John XXIII
documents.description: Reviews and extends Catholic social teaching on work, property, agriculture and international solidarity.

documents.title: Pacem in Terris — Encyclical on Establishing Universal Peace
documents.author: John XXIII
documents.description: Addressed to all people of good will, it sets out the rights and duties of persons and the conditions for peace among nations.

documents.title: Ecclesiam Suam — Encyclical on the Church
documents.author: Paul VI
documents.description: Reflects on the Church's self-awareness, renewal and the character of her dialogue with the world.

documents.title: Mysterium Fidei — Encyclical on the Holy Eucharist
documents.author: Paul VI
documents.description: Restates Catholic teaching on the Eucharist, including the real presence and the sacrifice of the Mass.

documents.title: Populorum Progressio — Encyclical on the Development of Peoples
documents.author: Paul VI
documents.description: Treats the integral development of persons and peoples and the duties of richer nations.

documents.title: Sacerdotalis Caelibatus — Encyclical on the Celibacy of the Priest
documents.author: Paul VI
documents.description: Defends and explains the discipline of priestly celibacy in the Latin Church.

documents.title: Humanae Vitae — Encyclical on the Regulation of Birth
documents.author: Paul VI
documents.description: Sets out the Church's teaching on conjugal love, responsible parenthood and the regulation of births.

documents.title: Marialis Cultus — Apostolic Exhortation on Devotion to the Blessed Virgin Mary
documents.author: Paul VI
documents.description: Gives guidance on the place of Marian devotion in the liturgy and in popular piety.

documents.title: Evangelii Nuntiandi — Apostolic Exhortation on Evangelization in the Modern World
documents.author: Paul VI
documents.description: Presents evangelization as the Church's essential mission and describes its content, means and agents.

documents.title: Redemptor Hominis — Encyclical on Christ the Redeemer
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: The first encyclical of John Paul II, centred on Christ as the redeemer of humanity and on the dignity of the human person.

documents.title: Catechesi Tradendae — Apostolic Exhortation on Catechesis in Our Time
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Reflects on the aims, content and methods of catechesis, following the 1977 Synod of Bishops.

documents.title: Dives in Misericordia — Encyclical on the Mercy of God
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Reflects on divine mercy as revealed in Scripture and in Christ, and on mercy in the life of the Church.

documents.title: Laborem Exercens — Encyclical on Human Work
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Treats human work as a key to the social question and sets out the dignity of workers and the priority of labour over capital.

documents.title: Familiaris Consortio — Apostolic Exhortation on the Role of the Christian Family
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Following the 1980 Synod, describes the tasks of the Christian family in the modern world and the pastoral care of families.

documents.title: Redemptoris Mater — Encyclical on the Blessed Virgin Mary in the Life of the Pilgrim Church
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Reflects on the role of Mary in the mystery of Christ and the Church, in preparation for the Marian Year of 1987-88.

documents.title: Sollicitudo Rei Socialis — Encyclical on Social Concern
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Marks twenty years since Populorum Progressio and examines authentic human development and solidarity.

documents.title: Mulieris Dignitatem — Apostolic Letter on the Dignity and Vocation of Women
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: A meditation on the dignity and vocation of women in the light of Scripture and the Marian Year.

documents.title: Redemptoris Missio — Encyclical on the Permanent Validity of the Church's Missionary Mandate
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Restates the urgency and content of the Church's mission to all peoples.

documents.title: Centesimus Annus — Encyclical on the Hundredth Anniversary of Rerum Novarum
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Reviews Rerum Novarum a century on and considers the economy, the state and human freedom after 1989.

documents.title: Veritatis Splendor — Encyclical on Certain Fundamental Questions of the Church's Moral Teaching
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Sets out foundations of Catholic moral teaching, freedom, conscience and intrinsically evil acts.

documents.title: Ordinatio Sacerdotalis — Apostolic Letter on Reserving Priestly Ordination to Men Alone
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: States that the Church has no authority to confer priestly ordination on women.

documents.title: Evangelium Vitae — Encyclical on the Value and Inviolability of Human Life
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Affirms the value of every human life and addresses abortion, euthanasia and the culture of death.

documents.title: Ut Unum Sint — Encyclical on Commitment to Ecumenism
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Reaffirms the Catholic commitment to Christian unity and reflects on the ministry of the Bishop of Rome.

documents.title: Fides et Ratio — Encyclical on the Relationship between Faith and Reason
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Considers the relation of faith and reason, revelation and philosophy, and the search for truth.

documents.title: Dies Domini — Apostolic Letter on Keeping the Lord's Day Holy
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: A reflection on Sunday as the Lord's day, the day of Christ's resurrection and of the Eucharistic assembly.

documents.title: Rosarium Virginis Mariae — Apostolic Letter on the Most Holy Rosary
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Recommends the Rosary as a Christ-centred prayer and proposes the Mysteries of Light.

documents.title: Ecclesia de Eucharistia — Encyclical on the Eucharist in Its Relationship to the Church
documents.author: John Paul II
documents.description: Reflects on the Eucharist as the source and summit of the Church's life, with attention to its apostolic and Marian dimensions.

documents.title: Sacramentum Caritatis — Apostolic Exhortation on the Eucharist
documents.author: Benedict XVI
documents.description: Following the 2005 Synod, reflects on the Eucharist as the sacrament of charity and on its celebration and consequences for life.

documents.title: Summorum Pontificum — Motu Proprio on the Use of the Roman Liturgy Prior to 1970
documents.author: Benedict XVI
documents.description: Regulated the use of the 1962 Roman Missal as an extraordinary form of the Roman Rite; later modified by Traditionis Custodes (2021).

documents.title: Caritas in Veritate — Encyclical on Integral Human Development in Charity and Truth
documents.author: Benedict XVI
documents.description: Develops Catholic social teaching on globalisation, the economy and development, with charity in truth as its guiding principle.

documents.title: Lumen Fidei — Encyclical on Faith
documents.author: Francis
documents.description: Begun by Benedict XVI and completed by Francis, it presents faith as a light that illuminates all of life.

documents.title: Laudato Si’ — Encyclical on Care for Our Common Home
documents.author: Francis
documents.description: Considers the human relation to creation, ecology and the economy, and calls for an integral ecology.

documents.title: Amoris Laetitia — Apostolic Exhortation on Love in the Family
documents.author: Francis
documents.description: Following two synods on the family, reflects on marriage, family life and pastoral accompaniment.

documents.title: Gaudete et Exsultate — Apostolic Exhortation on the Call to Holiness in Today's World
documents.author: Francis
documents.description: Reflects on the universal call to holiness, taking the Beatitudes as a guide.

documents.title: Fratelli Tutti — Encyclical on Fraternity and Social Friendship
documents.author: Francis
documents.description: Calls for universal fraternity and social friendship, drawing on the parable of the Good Samaritan.

documents.title: Dilexit Nos — Encyclical on the Human and Divine Love of the Heart of Jesus Christ
documents.author: Francis
documents.description: Reflects on devotion to the Sacred Heart and the human and divine love of Christ.

documents.title: Dilexi Te — Apostolic Exhortation on Love for the Poor
documents.author: Leo XIV
documents.description: Presents love for the poor as part of the Christian faith, drawing on Scripture and the Church's tradition.
